sentences.en: Snippy had the bluest blood of all his crab brethren.
sentences.zh: Snippy 的血统比所有的螃蟹兄弟都要高贵。

sentences.en: We, by ourselves, are able to, without a typical crab.
sentences.zh: 我们能够独自做到这一点，并不需要像典型的螃蟹那样。

sentences.en: Most gulls include crabs and small fish in their diet.
sentences.zh: 大多数海鸥的饮食包括螃蟹和小鱼。

senses.zh: 螃蟹；蟹肉；脾气乖戾的人；起重机
